div.head: Appendix
div.p:
Initiation of the recommended course of action will require a broadening of national objectives and accomplishment of the actions listed below: a.
Obtain from the President authority to employ atomic weapons. b.
Obtain concurrence of as many of the United Nations participants in Korea as possible in a decision to employ offensive military measures. c.
Secure governmental approval of necessary increase in funds to support the recommended operations. d.
Defer critical items of equipment and ammunition from NATO and other MDA programs as necessary. e.
Increase U.S. military personnel ceilings and accelerate production rates for certain types of ammunition and critical items of equipment. f.
Augment U.S. and ROK forces as required. g.
Increase the military preparedness of Japan. h.
Initiate the necessary psychological, political, economic and unconventional warfare measures in support of the military campaign. i.
Intensify guerrilla operations against Communist China. j.
Prepare plans and make preparations for the use of atomic weapons. k.
Extend the area for pursuit and air-to-air action to include Manchuria and North China. l.
Undertake air reconnaissance of essential target systems in China and Manchuria. m.
Launch an air offensive to the extent of capabilities against the Communist air complexes and other targets north of the Yalu River to destroy the Chinese Communist Air Force and, as capabilities increase, intensify air and naval attacks against Communist LOCs in North Korea, China and Manchuria at times to be determined by CINCFE. n.
Be prepared to establish a naval blockade and conduct a mining campaign (including aerial mining) against Communist China, supplemented by air attacks against air base complexes and LOCs in China and Manchuria, at a time to be determined. o.
Institute deceptive measures, including amphibious and airborne feints and raids as feasible, with strong naval and air support, in order
to draw the enemy off balance, to keep him confused as to U.N. intentions, and to insure maximum effect from massed air attacks in the battle area. p.
Launch an aggressive land campaign, in conjunction with strong amphibious attacks and supported by airborne envelopments to exploit enemy weaknesses, aimed at encirclement and destruction or neutralization of major enemy forces and leading to seizure and consolidation of Hungnam–Sinanju objectives. Following with pursuit and mopup operations as necessary in North Korea. q.
Prepare plans for support of operations by Chinese Nationalists, as feasible, to create diversions from Korea. r.
Maintain the security of Japan, the Philippines, Formosa, and the Ryukyus, consistent with the need to provide for the over-all security of U.S. forces.
